Package org.smtlib

Class SymbolTable

java.lang.Object
org.smtlib.SymbolTable
public class SymbolTable extends Object
This class manages a symbol table used for storing definitions and looking up ids in expressions. The table maps names to Entry objects that hold information about the defined symbol.

    • addSortParameter

      public boolean addSortParameter(IExpr.ISymbol symbol, boolean global)
      Adds the given symbol as a sort to the top scope of the sort table; returns false if the given symbol is already in the top scope (and the sort table is unchanged); returns true if the symbol is not already in the top scope.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the symbol to add
      Returns:
      true if successfully added, false if already present

    • addSortDefinition

      public boolean addSortDefinition(IExpr.IIdentifier identifier, IExpr.INumeral arity, List<IExpr.IAttribute<?>> attributes, boolean global)
      Adds a new sort family definition, with attributes (e.g. :right-assoc; null or empty if none), to the given frame (global = background, else current).
      Parameters:
      identifier - the identifier of the new Sort definition
      arity - the arity of the new Sort definition
      attributes - any attributes declared on the sort symbol (null or empty if none)
      global - if true, add to the background frame; otherwise add to the current frame
      Returns:
      true if successfully added, false if there already is a sort (in any scope) with this identifier

      Adds a new sort abbreviation definition to the given frame (global = background, else current).
      Parameters:
      identifier - the name of the new Sort definition
      parameters - the names of the parameters of the Sort abbreviation
      definition - the expression of the Sort abbreviation
      global - if true, add to the background frame; otherwise add to the current frame

    • lookup

      public ISort lookup(IExpr.IIdentifier name, List<ISort> argSorts, ISort resultSort, StringBuilder reason)
      Lookup a Symbol with the given name and argument Sorts and result Sort.
      Parameters:
      name - the name to find
      argSorts - the Sorts of the arguments
      resultSort - the expected result sort (from an `as` qualifier), or null if none given
      reason - if not null and this call returns null because some candidate(s) were found for `name` but none matched, set to a diagnostic message: the one candidate's own specific reason if there was exactly one, or a generic "no match" message listing the available signatures if there was more than one (overloading is rare, so a pile of per-candidate reasons is more noise than help once there's more than one to explain). Left untouched if `name` has no declared candidates at all, or if a match is found.
      Returns:
      the result Sort of the matching declaration, or null if none matches
